name: unsafe fn downgrade (& self)
rule: To call `RwLock::downgrade` safely, the `RwLock` must be write-locked with a single writer.
api: impl  std::sys::sync::rwlock::futex::RwLock { unsafe fn downgrade (& self) }
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: `state` is an opaque `Futex`, and no observation exposes write-lock status or writer count.
